canonical_definition: The observable behavior of a model shortening or summarizing a generated rationale or chain of thought, aiming to preserve its core logical steps while reducing length.
expert_removed_reason: method/technique: compressing chains of thought (including replacing them with gist tokens) is an inference-efficiency technique, not an LLM ability or task behavior.
papers: TokenSkip: Controllable Chain-of-Thought Compression in LLMs

definitions.text: The observable act of replacing a verbose reasoning segment with a compact representation (e.g., gist tokens), discarding the original chain while continuing inference.
The observable behavior of generating a condensed chain-of-thought by selectively omitting tokens deemed less semantically important, thereby reducing the total output length.
